annual.description: One value per year in 'years'. Keys: coffee_yield_green_kg_ha: Green coffee bean yield harvested in the year (kg/ha); coffee_gpp_t_c_ha: Coffee gross primary production (t C/ha/yr); coffee_npp_t_c_ha: Coffee net primary production (t C/ha/yr); coffee_lai_mean: Mean coffee leaf area index; coffee_biomass_t_c_ha: Coffee biomass carbon at year end: leaves, shoots, stump + coarse roots, fine roots, fruit (t C/ha); coffee_reserves_t_c_ha: Coffee carbon reserves at year end (t C/ha); tree_gpp_t_c_ha: Shade tree gross primary production (t C/ha/yr); tree_npp_t_c_ha: Shade tree net primary production (t C/ha/yr); tree_lai_mean: Mean shade tree leaf area index; tree_biomass_t_c_ha: Shade tree biomass carbon at year end: leaves, stem, branches, coarse + fine roots (t C/ha); tree_dbh_cm: Shade tree diameter at breast height at year end (cm); tree_height_m: Shade tree height at year end (m); tree_density_per_ha: Shade trees per hectare at year end; tree_light_transmittance_mean: Mean fraction of light passing the shade tree canopy; rain_mm: Rainfall (mm); evapotranspiration_mm: System evapotranspiration (mm); runoff_mm: Surface runoff (mm); drainage_mm: Drainage below the root zone (mm); days: Simulated days in the year
annual.title: Annual

daily.description: Only when daily_variables is set: 'date' plus one list per variable
daily.title: Daily

cycles.description: Plantation cycles simulated (a new one starts after coffee.AgeCoffeeMax years)
cycles.title: Cycles
